source: Components are the building blocks of your Nuxt application. They are reusable Vue instances that can be used to create a user interface. In Nuxt, components from the components directory are automatically imported by default. However, if you need to import components from an alternative directory or wish to selectively import them as needed, {0} provides the {1} and {2} methods. These utils allow you to customize the component configuration to better suit your needs.
